notes.title: Final Testing Phase
notes.content:
All planned content has been added and fixed. Other than the last 2 story chapters, I need your ideas for what else to fix or add.

[h1]If no more feedback is offered, the game will release on 4 July 2024.[/h1]

[h2]The price of the Expansion Pack will increase from 1.99 USD to 4.99 USD (or regional equivalent) on release, which was originally planned for last March.[/h2]

I don't quite like where the game is at the moment, but I've done what I can to fix it. A few tweaks are still needed but overall this is about as much as I think fits the game. The plan right now is to save major changes for a sequel (art rework, shorter move speeds, ability reworks, GUI rework, control rework). The current game was an experiment to see if I could make a space mech chess game that's controllled with just movement. I have my opinion, but I want to see what others think, and I think a full release might be the best way to get that feedback, both to improve this game, and for the sequel.

I won't abandon this game after release, but it is content-complete except in terms of story. There are 2 story chapters I will add to the Expansion Pack if people like the game (or want more content).

Thank you to everyone who's tried out this experimental game. Your time and feedback is greatly appreciated.

-slizer88

notes.title: Campaign Mode Added
notes.content:
[h1]Tired of single matches? Try a tournament mode.[/h1]

You have eight missions to complete. Each mission consists of a different location stage, and a different enemy boss unit.

You can choose which maniple to send on each mission, according to their strengths and weaknesses. For example, you will have to send one maniple to the Space location. The Saviour or Argent might be poor choices here due to the lack of cover, so you could send a faster maniple like the White One or Templar. If the boss unit in the Space location is the Banrigh, you might want to avoid using the Templar because of its low health.

[list]
[*] Mission Success: that maniple is no longer available for the remaining missions.
[*] Mission Failure: the mission remains available, and you must try it again with as a rescue mission with another maniple.
[*] Rescue Mission: the rescuing maniple is no longer available, and the rescued maniples become available for your remaining missions.
[/list]

I think this is quite nice mode. I usually play the All Random mode, but now you can avoid the randomness in favour of making strategic choices.

notes.content:
Lone King v1.20 adds:

[list]
[*] Parallax effects on asteroids, Earth, Moon, Sun, satellites, and ships. Stars and the Milky Way now move with the view.
[*] The Moon level now has more bases on it, tiles are placed better
[*] The Base level now has tight hallways as it should, with improved walls
[*] You can now move outside the map to make it easier to attack enemies too close to the edge. This would have been very difficult to get right without this. You cannot stay outside the map and are forced to move back into the map next turn. Currently you get stuck if you can't return to the map.
[*] Destinations with no damage are now shown in a brighter green when using the move scanner. The damage text indicator is now drawn on the UI to avoid it being covered.
[*] All player, enemy, terrain, and effects now have depth so they overlap properly.
[*] General art asset improvements
[/list]
